the role of Endo180 and LOX as regulators of prostate cancer cell plastic migration on human ECMs.

the tumor cell receptor Endo180 requires the ECM stiffening factor LOX to promote the metastatic progression of prostate cancer.

The main takeaway from our work is that
metastasizing prostate cancer cells can adopt different modes of migration on human stromal-derived matrices and that Endo180 and stromal-derived LOXL2 are key players in this plasticity.
